faq.a: Melih is associated with the Arabic form مَلِيح, whose core sense is melih; handsome, good-looking.

faq.q: What is the origin of Melih?
faq.a: Melih is associated with Arabic. Melih is Arabic مَلِيح (Malīḥ), meaning 'handsome, good-looking'. It is widely used as a male given name in Turkey.
Yes — the underlying form مَلِيح is Arabic.
Melih can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
